# betterado_git_repository (Resource)

Manages a Git repository in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

resource "betterado_git_repository" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "ExampleRepo"

  initialization {
    init_type = "Clean"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the git repository.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the repository belongs to.

### Optional

- `default_branch` (String) The ref of the default branch.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the repository is disabled.
- `initialization` (Block List) How the repository is initialized. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--initialization))
- `parent_repository_id` (String) The ID of a Git repository from which a fork is to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_fork` (Boolean) True if the repository was created as a fork.
- `remote_url` (String) Git HTTPS clone URL.
- `size` (Number) Size of the repository in bytes.
- `ssh_url` (String) Git SSH clone URL.
- `url` (String) REST API URL for the repository.
- `web_url` (String) Web URL for the repository.

<a id="nestedblock--initialization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initialization`

Required:

- `init_type` (String) The type of repository initialization. Valid values are `Clean`, `Fork`, `Import`, `Uninitialized`.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for importing a private repository.
- `service_connection_id` (String) The ID of a service connection for authentication when importing.
- `source_type` (String) Type of the source repository. Only `Git` is supported.
- `source_url` (String) The URL of the source repository.
- `username` (String) The username for importing a private repository.
